description: Validate and normalise one identifier whose type you know (format, length, dates and check digits). Returns valid, compact and formatted forms, the checks performed, a reason when invalid, and extracted details where the number encodes them (birth date, sex, holder type). Example: number '784-1990-1234567-1', code 'ae_emirates_id'. Response: result plus data_confidence (high = check-digit algorithm from a public specification; medium = community-documented checksum or pattern-only; low = structure only), estimated_items[], sources[], data_version and a disclaimer (structural validation only — never proof that an identifier is issued or belongs to someone).

code.description: Identifier code from list_identifiers, e.g. 'ae_emirates_id', 'sa_national_id', 'fr.siret', 'gb.vat', 'us.ein', 'in.pan', 'br.cpf', 'isbn', 'lei', 'imei'. A bare suffix like 'siret' also works when unique.
code.title: Code

number.description: The identifier as written (spaces, dashes and dots are tolerated).
number.title: Number
